commentary: August revenue of [[revenue.month.actual]] came in above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] ([[revenue.month.vs_budget_pct]]) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]] ([[revenue.month.vs_py_pct]]), with gross margin of [[gross_margin.month.actual]] running above budget by [[gross_margin.month.vs_budget_pp]] and operating profit of [[operating_profit.month.actual]] well above budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]] ([[operating_profit.month.vs_budget_pct]]).
